title: Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
body:
Haye Sayyeda
Haye Sayyeda
Haye Ali
Ye Gurbate Ali Hai (2x)
Jalta Hua Darwaza Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
Dil Thamke Ye Manzar Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
1) Bade Nabi Ummat ne Kya Zulm Kiya Hai,
Darbar Me Hai Zahra Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
2) Aye Hai Dare Fatema Zahra Ko Jalane,
Jalte Hua Sholoko Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
3) Ummat K Amirone Jalaya Dare Zahra,
Ye Ajre Risalat Ka Ali Dekh Rahey Hai.
4) Haider Ki Wilayat Lea Ghar Ghar Gayi Bibi,
Ye Bebasi e Zahra Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
5) Mohsin Ki Sahadat Ko Baya Keyse Karu Mai,
Na Usne Dekha Duniya Ali Dekh Rahey Hai.
6) Ummat Ne Sataya Vare Darbar Me Ayse,
Zahra Hui Jayifa Ali Dekh Rahey Hai.
7) Jab Akey Ali Gusl o Kafan Dene Lage They,
Pehlu Vi Tha Sikasta Ali Dekh Rahey Hai.
8) Kehta Hai Zulfiqar Ye Ay Yousuf e Zahra,
Mismar Hai Baqaiya Ali Dekh Rahey Hai.
Jalta Hua Darwaza Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
Dil Thamke Ye Manzar Ali Dekh Rahey Hai
